verdict.rationale: stagewise's enterprise page lists SSO with OIDC and SAML, plus SCIM provisioning and optional self-hosting of the stagewise Cloud. Its custom-provider docs also support cloud-platform model access through Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock and Google Vertex AI. Both enterprise-identity and cloud-platform authentication are first-party documented, though only as brief listings. Missing for 10: in-depth SSO/SAML/SCIM setup documentation, details on IAM/credential configuration for Bedrock/Vertex/Azure, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can authenticate through an enterprise identity or cloud platform for compliance and scalability
